_note: Hover help for this project's buttons, menu items and tabs (project-owned). Key = the control's text, optionally preceded by where it is: tab / sub-tab / group box titles (outermost first) or a dialog's title, joined with ' > '. The most specific match wins; '&', a trailing '...' and case are ignored. An empty text = no tooltip on purpose. Engine controls (developer buttons, Environment tab, OK / Cancel / Close ...) already have entries in Base\Services_ToolTips.psm1; an entry here overrides them. The developer build lists every control still missing one in <data root>\Logs\ToolTips_missing.txt.

ToolTips.Overview: What is active right now, the last password sent, and Pause / Resume for every hotkey.
ToolTips.Password Config: Set up the 5 password slots: name, password, hotkey, how it is sent. Nothing changes until Save.
ToolTips.Overview > Pause hotkeys: Turn every password hotkey off until you resume them. Nothing is typed while paused.
ToolTips.Overview > Resume hotkeys: Turn the password hotkeys back on.
ToolTips.Password Config > Show: Reveal this slot's saved password in the box. Untick (or lock the window) to hide it again.
ToolTips.Password Config > Forget: Remove this slot's saved password and turn the slot off when you click Save.
ToolTips.Password Config > Save: Save every slot and option and re-register the hotkeys. Passwords are encrypted with your Windows account (DPAPI).
ToolTips.Password Config > Revert: Throw away unsaved edits and reload the saved settings.
ToolTips.Password Config > Minimize to the system: On: minimizing hides the window to the tray icon; the hotkeys keep working.
ToolTips.Password Config > Start with hotkeys pau: On: PDubPaste starts with every hotkey paused until you resume them.
ToolTips.Unlock: Sign in with Windows Hello or your Windows password to show the settings (and start the hotkeys after launch).
ToolTips.Exit: Close PDubPaste. Every hotkey stops working.
ToolTips.PDubPaste > Unlock: Check this Windows password and unlock the window. After 3 wrong tries the window stays locked.
ToolTips.PDubPaste > Use Windows Hello: Switch to Windows Hello (face, fingerprint or PIN) instead of typing the password.
ToolTips.PDubPaste > Cancel: Close this box. The window stays locked.
ToolTips.Tray > Open: Show the PDubPaste window (asks you to sign in with Windows first).
ToolTips.Tray > Pause hotkeys: Turn every password hotkey off until you resume them.
ToolTips.Tray > Resume hotkeys: Turn the password hotkeys back on (unlock the window first).
ToolTips.Tray > Exit: Close PDubPaste. Every hotkey stops working.
